jurisdiction_sources.note: 16 V.S.A. section 603(a)(4)(B) inventory: Rutland Town School District, a town school district in the Greater Rutland County Supervisory Union (member town: Rutland Town). Distinct from the Rutland City School District.
Greater Rutland County Supervisory Union (official site).

board.post_note: Rutland Town SD: five directors at-large under 16 V.S.A. section 423(a)-(b), elected by Australian ballot. All five seats are now filled (the two held seats were resolved by the certified March 3, 2026 return -- see the board sources).

sources.note: Town of Rutland FY2025 Annual Report (official): the elected-officials table (p. 59) publishes the five school directors with terms -- Hammond 2024-2026 (Chair), Fingon 2023-2026, Colomb 2024-2027, Mullin 2025-2027 (Clerk), Hamilton 2025-2028 -- and the district warning printed in the same report (p. 80) warns exactly two seats for the March 3, 2026 Australian ballot (one 2-year, one 3-year), matching Hammond's and Fingon's expiring terms. Both held seats were resolved by the certified March 3, 2026 return (see the return source).

Town of Rutland Official Return of Votes (Elections Division, Office of the Secretary of State), election 03/03/2026 -- March Town Meeting 2026, certified by Kari Clark, Clerk and Treasurer (official; the document Town Clerk Kari Clark pointed to in her 2026-10-26 reply to CivicMirror's records request): School Board 2 years -- Tim Hammond 507 (East district) + 136 (West district) = 643; School Board 3 years -- Collin Fingon 480 + 127 = 607. Hammond and Fingon are ELECTED to the two warned seats, ends '2028' and '2029'.

Town of Rutland, Elected and Appointed Officials page (official): Hammond (Chair) term to 3/2028 and Fingon term to 3/2029, corroborating the certified return; the same page's Colomb 2027, Mullin 2027 and Hamilton 2028 entries match the FY2025 report and the existing build.
